note: Copy this file to resources/wordlist.json and replace the placeholders. That file is
gitignored on purpose, so the words themselves never reach the repository, and the
server refuses to boot without it rather than run an unfiltered chat.
blocked:       masked in chat, and refused in usernames. Matched as whole words, seeing
through lookalike characters, repeats, separators and words run together.
severe:        the subset of `blocked` matched anywhere in the text, letters either side
or not, so padding a word out cannot hide it. Every entry must also be in
`blocked`. Only put a word here if no ordinary word contains it.
clean:         innocent words that contain a `severe` word, spared in chat. Whole words
only, so list the inflections you need.
usernameOnly:  refused in usernames but not masked in chat. A name is worn permanently,
so the bar for it is lower.
usernameClean: innocent words that contain a `blocked` or `usernameOnly` word, allowed in
usernames, which are matched by substring because a name has no spaces.
